verdict.rationale: First-party docs say ChatGPT can "read files, analyze data, and summarize findings" and "analyze files." The Work overview implies cloud conversations accept uploaded files, and a community user praises the file-upload/interpretation capability. The evidence is brief one-liners, though: it never documents per-format upload of spreadsheets and PDFs for analysis, and nothing corroborates accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of uploading spreadsheets and PDFs for analysis, supported formats and limits, evidence of analysis accuracy, hands-on corroboration of file analysis.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: read files, analyze data, and summarize findings
Create a deck, analyze files, draft a report, build a project plan
Unlike Work on the Web, local Work can operate on resources that remain on your computer without requiring you to upload files to a cloud conversation.
The browser and file-upload/interpretation plugins are great
